mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing partly cloudy skies near the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 74 degrees, plus an air quality index of 52.
The City of Verona has officially unveiled the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School, a new public art piece created by Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland.
We have plenty going on, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia today, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.

In a report covering calls from August 24th through August 31st, the Verona Police Department noted they successfully caught individuals involved in a ding-dong-ditch incident on a day during that period.
Stop by for today's delicious flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl. The Verona location is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
